case_number: 2024 INSC 752; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(s). ________OF 2024 [Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Criminal) No.1415 of 2024 and No.1416 of 2024]
summary: Quashing of criminal proceedings; offences under IPC & Prevention of Corruption Act; One-Time Settlement (OTS) with bank concluded before DRT; no active role of accused women in fraudulent scheme; continuance of proceedings unjustified after debt discharge; reliance on precedent permitting quashing in commercial disputes settled amicably; remote conviction prospects; remote possibility of conviction in settled commercial disputes; quashing under Section 482 CrPC proper.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.120-B, s.420, s.468, s.471
Prevention of Corruption Act 1988 s.13(2) read with s.13(1)(d)
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned High Court orders permitting plea urging at trial stage set aside; criminal proceedings quashed.
